The '''Kaikielius campaign''' took place in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the battle was part of [[Operation Durge's Lance]] lead by Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

An aberrant [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was present during this battle, and suffered a paranoid delusion while on a reconnaissance mission: he killed all of his fellow batchers and was later recovered sitting docilely on an outcropping, surrounded by their bodies. Interrogated by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]], he insisted that the entire Kaikielius campaign was a training exercise and believed that commando droids disguised in [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] had replaced his squad. Owing to this incident he was dubbed "[[Mad Clone of Kaikielius|the Mad Clone of Kaikielius]]" by [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] commentators.
